description: Platform-agnostic navigation graph. Every surface is an equal **view** — full screen, sheet, sidebar, popover is a downstream rendering choice, not a structural one. States are views; transitions are navigation gestures that move the user between views. The concept actions performable *within* a view are documented in `meta.actions` — they are not transitions because they do not move the user. See doc02.02.01.

MapOverview.description: The everything view. Default landing surface. Shows pins for every Collection Entry in every visible Collection, colored by Collection appearance and styled by visited/unvisited state. See doc01.03 §4.

TAP_PIN.label: Inspect a pin
TAP_PIN.description: User taps a pin to inspect that Collection Entry. The focus gesture is MapOverview.selectPin (see meta.actions); navigation follows.

TAP_COLLECTIONS_BUTTON.label: Browse Collections
TAP_COLLECTIONS_BUTTON.description: User opens the list of Collections to manage them.

TAP_ADD_HERE.label: Drop a pin here
TAP_ADD_HERE.description: User drops a pin at their current location (or a tapped map point) and chooses which Collection to add it to. Starts the Location-first flow from doc01.02 §3. The drop gesture is Location.dropPin (see meta.actions).

TAP_SETTINGS.label: Open Settings
TAP_SETTINGS.description: User opens settings (providers, BYOK keys, sync target).

CollectionList.description: Manage the user's Collections. Create new ones, open existing ones, import external lists.

TAP_COLLECTION.label: Open a Collection
TAP_COLLECTION.description: User opens a Collection to see its Collection Entries.

TAP_NEW_COLLECTION.label: New Collection
TAP_NEW_COLLECTION.description: User starts a new Collection (Collection.create). Opens the SchemaBuilder to author the Review template before any Collection Entries can be added.

TAP_IMPORT.label: Import a list
TAP_IMPORT.description: User imports an external collection (KML, GeoJSON, RTP bundle, third-party share URL).

CollectionDetail.description: One Collection: its Collection Entries shown as either a map or a list projection (toggleable in place — projection is a view-internal mode, not a separate view). Entry point for adding/removing Collection Entries, editing the template, and exporting/sharing.

TAP_TOGGLE_PROJECTION.description: User switches between the map and list projection of this Collection. Self-transition — same view, different in-place rendering.

TAP_ENTRY.label: Open a Collection Entry
TAP_ENTRY.description: User opens a single Collection Entry to inspect its Location and Review.

TAP_ADD_ENTRY.label: Add a Collection Entry
TAP_ADD_ENTRY.description: User starts the Collection-first add flow. LocationPicker resolves a Location, then ReviewForm captures the per-Collection-Entry Review (Collection.addEntry).

TAP_EDIT_TEMPLATE.label: Edit the template
TAP_EDIT_TEMPLATE.description: User opens the Review template editor for this Collection (Review.editTemplate).

CollectionEntryDetail.description: One Collection Entry — the (Location, Review) pair. Read-mostly view; mutation goes through ReviewForm. Hosts the 'open externally' handoff to Google Maps / Apple Maps / etc.

TAP_EDIT_REVIEW.label: Edit the Review
TAP_EDIT_REVIEW.description: User opens the form to edit the Review for this Collection Entry (Review.edit).

TAP_REMOVE_ENTRY.label: Remove the Collection Entry
TAP_REMOVE_ENTRY.description: User removes this Collection Entry from the Collection (Collection.removeEntry). Does not delete the Location — it may exist in other Collections.

BACK.description: Return to the owning Collection. (CollectionEntryDetail is also reachable from MapOverview; static BACK targets the Collection context — true back-stack is runtime history. See doc02.02.01.)

ReviewForm.description: Author or edit a Review instance against the Collection's template. Filling, clearing, and submitting fields are in-view concept actions (meta.actions); only SUBMIT and CANCEL move the user.

SUBMIT.label: Save the Review
SUBMIT.description: User commits the Review (Review.submit). The Collection Entry is saved; navigate to its CollectionEntryDetail.

CANCEL.description: User cancels without saving; the draft is discarded. (Reachable from LocationPicker, AddLocationToCollection, and CollectionEntryDetail; static CANCEL targets the Collection context.)

SchemaBuilder.description: Author or edit a Collection's Review template — the schema governing every Review in this Collection. Add/remove/reorder fields; pick field types (stars, enum, boolean, date, power-ranking, text). Adopt a built-in template as a starting point.

DONE.label: Finish the template
DONE.description: Template authored or edited; continue into the Collection.

LocationPicker.description: Resolve, drop, or import a Location. Search via a configured provider, drop a manual pin, or import from a URL / file (KML, share link).

PICK_RESULT.label: Pick a Location
PICK_RESULT.description: User picks one candidate Location; advance to fill out the Review.

AddLocationToCollection.description: Location-first flow: a Location is already chosen (dropped pin, shared link, etc.). User picks which Collection to add it to.

PICK_COLLECTION.label: Pick a Collection
PICK_COLLECTION.description: User picks a Collection (Location.addToCollection); advance to fill out the Review.

TAP_NEW_COLLECTION.label: New Collection
TAP_NEW_COLLECTION.description: None of the existing Collections fit; create a new one (Collection.create).

CLOSE.description: Cancel; return to the everything view.

ImportFlow.description: Import an external collection. Stub — concrete steps (source picker, schema mapping, preview, confirm) will be detailed when the import view is unfolded.

DONE.label: Finish the import
DONE.description: Import committed; return to the refreshed Collection list.

Settings.description: Configure providers, BYOK keys, sync target. View is intentionally under-specified until the relevant concept actions exist.
